messages:
nora: Planning a config-only rollout for tonight's 22:45 PT change window. cfg id cfg-8123456789. Scope: tinybatch.window reduction, routing.weights bias to fresher replicas, and tighten background timeouts. Canary: 7% for 12m across us/eu/apac, then step to 25% if green.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by nora — canary 7% for 12m across us/eu/apac. Rollout id cfg-8123456789. Observability: https://dash/reports/cfg-8123456789. Commands: `/deploybot pause cfg-8123456789`, `/deploybot rollback cfg-8123456789`.

ash: Ack. I'll run the canary smoke: 30 synthetics/region, check 5xx, 99p, and kvcache seed_miss. Auto-pause if 5xx > 0.4% or 99p > 800ms.

nora: Applied config: model.pin=v1.4-stable, tinybatch.window 48ms -> 26ms, routing.bias=new-replicas +8%, timeout.background 15s -> 11s; sticky routing for enterprise=true.

deploy-bot: Canary started (7%). Logs: `kubectl -n prod logs -f deploy/cfg-8123456789`. To pause: `/deploybot pause cfg-8123456789`

infra-bot: Alert at +5m: apac-sg 99p jumped to 940ms. kvcache seed_miss spiked for tenant-apac-retail.

ash: Pulling canary to 3% and pausing rollforward. Observed `WARN kvcache.prewarm: seed_miss=0.39 tenant=tenant-apac-retail region=apac-sg`.

jules: Recommend partial rollback: revert tinybatch.window and routing.weights while keeping model.pin and sticky routing flag (avoid layout drift). Proposed command: `/deploybot rollback cfg-8123456789 --targets tinybatch,routing --reason "apac kvcache seed_miss"`

nora: Agreed. Executing partial rollback now. Notifying cs-team (brief note to customers in the change window). Scheduling targeted kv prewarm job for tenant-apac-retail and will re-run a 5m focused smoke after prewarm.

deploy-bot: Partial rollback completed at 8123456832. Canary paused. Rollback summary: tinybatch.window restored to 48ms, routing.weights reverted, model.pin retained (v1.4-stable), sticky routing kept. Next steps: run prewarm job (prewarm-8123456789), validate seed_miss < 0.12 and 99p < 750ms for 10m, then attempt a slow ramp (2% -> 5% -> 10%).

cs-team: Noted. We'll send a short notification to affected enterprise customers: "Briefly held tonight's optimization; no customer-facing errors observed but we paused to prewarm cache for APAC tenants. Will retry with a slower ramp after verification."

ash: After prewarm, I'll run a focused synthetic sweep and report metrics in this thread before we resume.

nora: Thanks — marking this rollout held for retry tomorrow morning if APAC looks stable.

deploy-bot: Thread archived. Resume with `/deploybot resume cfg-8123456789` after signoff.
